notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.112

Clear QuickBooks errors: when QuickBooks can’t be read, every page now shows “QuickBooks could not be reached:” with QuickBooks’ own message, instead of “Something went wrong on the server”.
Message box tip: if a QuickBooks message box is the cause, the page says to close it on the server where the QuickBooks helper runs, then try again.
Treasurer’s report: it has a Try again button after a failure, and it tells you straight away when the QuickBooks helper isn’t running.
Error log: QuickBooks errors are still kept under Settings → Diagnostics.
